cards.title: FF06B5 Ouroboros
cards.description: The symbol was found in a hidden chamber at the bottom of a newly added location 'Destroyed Bastion'. It's visible on wall to the right after entering the chamber. The symbol clearly features the vampiric ouroboros but with some changes and added text.

cards.title: Tdet Tribe Symbol
cards.description: The symbol of the vampiric Tdet tribe visible in both Tesham Mutna and Unseen Elder's cave. What's interesting here is that the symbol uses the exact same snake as on the vampiric ouroboros.

cards.title: Unseen Elder's Cave
cards.description: Vampiric ouroboros visible above an arch when leaving the cave with the inverted gravity inside of the Unseen Elder's cave. This is the pure vampiric ouroboros with its base colors, and without any text.

cards.title: Tesham Mutna Chamber
cards.description: Another vampiric ouroboros visible in the chamber at the very bottom of Tesham Mutna. The symbol is partially covered by rubble and it's rather large so you can easily miss it. The chamber in which it was located was used as jail for vampire Khagmar.

cards.title: Regis's Glove
cards.description: Visible on Regis's glove which suggests that the symbol has a deep cultural meaning since it's a part of his attire.

cards.title: Regis's Bag
cards.description: Visible on Regis's bag which suggests that the symbol has a deep cultural meaning since it's a part of his attire. Unlike the regular vampiric ouroboros this one has the loops on the inside. Additionally it features a different center, 4 convex lines resembling a diamond shape.

cards.title: Regis's Tunic Chain
cards.description: Visible on Regis's tunic brooches which suggests that the symbol has a deep cultural meaning since it's a part of his attire. Unlike the regular vampiric ouroboros this one has the loops on the inside. Additionally it features a different center, 4 convex lines resembling a diamond shape.

cards.title: Tesham Mutna Door Seal
cards.description: When entering Tesham Mutna with Regis he waves his hand in front of a sealed door. Afterwards a vampiric ouroboros shaped red seal appears on its surface. Regis exclaims that it's a form of protection against unwanted guests, and the the mechanism reacts only to the higher vampire's blood.
